simple.summary: כְּסָלוֹן (Kᵉçâlôwn) means Kesalon , a place in Palestine First listed occurrence: Josh 15 10.

definitions.full: H3693. Kesalon כְּסָלוֺן proper name, of a location on border of tribe of Judah = הַריְֿעָרִים Josh 15:10 ; = Kesla 10miles west of Jerusalem, Guérin Jud. ii. 11 ff. Mem iii. 25. 26 Buhl G. § 92, p. 166 .
